exclude:
compilerOptions": {
    "composite": true,
    "tsBuildInfoFile": "./node_modules/.tmp/tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo",

    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["./src/*"]
    },

    "allowJs": true,
    "checkJs": false,
    "strict": false,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "noImplicitAny": false,
    "noImplicitReturns": false,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": false,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": false
  }
}
